name: netftp
description: TCP on the kernel stack over the wire: a passive ftp get from a real server, its control and data connections both the kernel's, checked with sum(1) against the host's copy.  The shipping rc.local is staged back.  NOT in the gate: a real server.  The network modules load at boot (/etc/rc), and the server's name is looked up through them.

requires.reason: the ftp server's name, one line; the tree does not name a server
